data.title: 长离 · 庭院里的授课
data.description: 庭院石桌，她与今汐对坐授课，一边沏茶一边以眼前事物借题发挥；温柔耐心的语调里藏着层层引导——好老师的课从不让人察觉在被教。

data.promptProse: Changli pours tea while teaching Jinhsi across the courtyard stone table, using nearby objects to guide the discussion. Her peach jacket covers a cream blouse above a long red skirt, expression patient and attentive. Keep both women and the cups distinct in the medium view, with garden branches behind. Dappled daylight illuminates their hands and teapot rim, leaving shifting leaf shadows on the stone and soft reflections beneath the cup glaze.
